newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-MONACO'S SCIFO AND PETERSEN TO ANDERLECHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MONACO'S SCIFO AND PETERSEN TO ANDERLECHT.

text.p: Belgium's Enzo Scifo and Denmark's Dan Petersen will leave Monaco at the end of the season to join Belgian club Anderlecht, Petersen said on Thursday.
Petersen confirmed Scifo had signed a three-year contract with the club with which he started his professional career.
Scifo's transfer had been announced last month but Monaco officials denied the move, saying negotations were under way.

Petersen, 26, who joined Monaco in 1994 from Ajax, said he had also signed a three-year contract with an option for two "They approached me through Enzo, who asked me if I may be interested," said Petersen, who has hardly played for Monaco since he was injured two years ago.
In his first season with the principality,s team, Petersen scored 15 goals.
